_comment: Places to eat in Paris: a long-term guide, no dates. Tiers are the categories (A Michelin Guide, B everyday tables, C cafés and sweets); costs are the price levels; awards are Michelin distinctions. See docs/GUIDES.md. 巴黎餐厅长期导览：分级就是类别（A 米其林，B 日常餐厅，C 咖啡与甜点），costs 是价位，awards 是米其林评级。
title: Eating in Paris, from a bowl of noodles to three stars.
titleZh: 在巴黎吃饭：从一碗面到米其林三星。
subtitle: {items} places to eat, sorted by category and price. Choose a cuisine or a price, and book the popular ones ahead.
subtitleZh: {items} 个吃饭的地方，按类别和价位分好。可以选菜系或价位；热门的餐厅请提前预订。

tiers.name: Michelin Guide
tiers.text: Stars, Bib Gourmand and the other picks of the 2026 Michelin Guide. Book ahead.
tiers.textZh: 2026 年米其林指南的星级餐厅、必比登推介和其他入选餐厅。请提前预订。

tiers.name: Everyday tables
tiers.text: Bistros, noodle bars, grills and neighbourhood favourites, for any day.
tiers.textZh: 小酒馆、面馆、烤肉和街坊常去的小店，哪天都合适。

tiers.name: Cafés and sweets
tiers.text: Coffee, tea, pastry and ice cream, and a few bars.
tiers.textZh: 咖啡、茶、甜点和冰淇淋，还有几家酒吧。

awards.name: In the Michelin Guide, without a star

paras.text: Places to eat in Paris, from a quick bowl of noodles to a three-star dinner. They come from a shared Google Maps list, and each was checked in November 2026 against the restaurant's own pages, the MICHELIN Guide and the press.
paras.textZh: 从一碗面到米其林三星，这里是在巴黎吃饭的地方。名单来自一份共享的 Google 地图列表，2026年11月逐一对照了餐厅官网、米其林指南和媒体报道。

paras.text: This guide has no dates: it grows over time. Nothing has been booked for you.
paras.textZh: 本导览没有固定日期，会不断更新。没有代为预订任何餐厅。

items.text: Michelin Guide: stars (★), Bib Gourmand and the guide's other picks (Guide). Everyday tables: restaurants for any day. Cafés and sweets: coffee, tea, pastry, ice cream and a few bars.
items.textZh: 米其林指南：星级（★）、必比登推介和指南的其他入选餐厅（指南）。日常餐厅：哪天都可以去的餐厅。咖啡与甜点：咖啡、茶、甜点、冰淇淋，还有几家酒吧。

items.text: € under €25 a head, €€ €25–50, €€€ €50–100, €€€€ over €100: food for one person, without drinks. The Price box shows one level at a time; Sort by can put the cheapest first.
items.textZh: € 人均 €25 以下，€€ €25–50，€€€ €50–100，€€€€ €100 以上：一个人的餐费，不含酒水。“价位”框一次显示一个价位；“排序方式”可以把便宜的排在前面。

items.text: Choose one in the Cuisine box, or type a dish, a name or a street in Find.
items.textZh: 在“菜系”框里选一种，或者在“查找”里输入菜名、店名或街道。

items.text: Starred and popular places fill up weeks ahead. Many restaurants close on Sunday and Monday, and for some weeks in August. Check the opening hours before you go.
items.textZh: 星级餐厅和热门餐厅往往要提前几周预订。很多餐厅周日、周一休息，八月还会停业几周。出发前请先确认营业时间。

paras.text: Prices are those the restaurant or the MICHELIN Guide gave in November 2026. Menus change with the seasons, so take them as a guide. Stars and Bib Gourmand are from the MICHELIN Guide France 2026.
paras.textZh: 价格以2026年11月餐厅或米其林指南公布的为准。菜单随季节变化，仅供参考。星级和必比登推介来自2026年米其林指南（法国）。

credits.points: Points: a shared Google Maps list
credits.pointsZh: 点位：一份共享的 Google 地图列表

defaults.price: Prices change: check the restaurant's own page.
defaults.priceZh: 价格会变动，请以餐厅官网为准。
